task.goal: What was the total duration of skate boarding activities in the OpenTracks app this week? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer in minutes as a single integer.
task.final_summary: Skate boarding this week (Monday, October 9 through Sunday, October 15, 2023) totalled 3 hours 25 minutes, which is 205 minutes. OpenTracks' aggregated stats for that date range list SKATE BOARDING with 2 tracks and a combined time of 3:25:00; the two skate boarding tracks in the list, "Lunch Break Fitness" (40:00) and "Need more strength and conditioning" (2:45:00), add up to exactly that.

steps.note: Observe current screen
Launch OpenTracks and observe its main screen
Advance/skip intro then reach track list
Advance intro pages until main screen
Open the overflow menu to look for activity-type filtering
Dismiss menu, open first track to inspect its activity type field
Open first track detail to see where activity type is shown
Inspect track detail overflow menu for activity type info
Open Edit on this track to see activity type field, then back out without saving
Read the edit screen fields
Cancel edit and return to track list
Return to track list, then open Aggregated stats
Inspect Aggregated stats screen for period and activity type grouping
Open Filter on Aggregated stats to set date range
Scroll filter dialog to reveal full date fields
Tap the 'from' date field to open date picker
Scroll dialog to show the calendar grid for the from-date picker
Select Oct 9 as from date, then set to-date Oct 15
Open to-date picker
Scroll to reveal to-date calendar and pick Oct 15
Select Oct 15 as to-date, then confirm filter with OK
Apply filter and read aggregated stats
Scroll aggregated stats list to its end to read all rows
Convert 3:25:00 to minutes and confirm with per-track times
Final read of aggregated stats then done
Confirm row then done
Task complete
